response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / NULLIF(AVG(rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM media_rates

assumptions.assumption: NULL Bytes follow SQL SUM behavior: they do not contribute to the byte total, while their tracks' Milliseconds remain in the time total.
